description: Every stored revision of one geopolitical event's source record, by event_id, showing how the publisher changed it over time; as_of limits it to what was known at a past cutoff. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

as_of.description: Knowledge cutoff with timezone, e.g. 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z; omit for latest.

event_id.description: Event ID from history results: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; 0 starts the first page.

name: geopolitical_event_revisions
title: Geopolitical Event Revisions
